title: Enterprise cost center pool to paid overage
summary: Enable the AI Innovation cost-center pool and show excess Enterprise usage rolling into metered budgets.

steps.title: Open the month with a first draw
steps.description: A week into the billing period Alice consumes 11,500 of the 38,900 credits included for the AI Innovation cost center.
steps.expected: Usage is accepted from the AI Innovation pool and paid overage remains $0.

steps.title: Continue drawing down the pool
steps.expected: Usage is accepted from the AI Innovation pool, leaving 18,000 included credits.

steps.title: Pass the halfway mark
steps.description: A further 10,000 included credits are consumed.
steps.expected: Usage is accepted from the AI Innovation pool, leaving 8,000 included credits.

steps.title: Use the AI Innovation pool
steps.description: The final 8,000 included credits available to the AI Innovation cost center are consumed.
steps.expected: The cost-center included pool reaches 100%, while paid overage remains $0.

steps.title: Roll into paid overage
steps.description: Alice consumes 2,400 more AI credits after the AI Innovation pool is exhausted.
steps.expected: The event is accepted as $24 of paid overage and the AI team metered budget reaches 80%, crossing its 75% threshold.
